title.narrative: Partnership to improve service delivery through strengthened Public Finance Management and Oversight (PFMO)

description.narrative: The project will focus on 2 main components: 1) Strengthening the effectiveness, integrity, transparency, accountability, citizen-orientation and control of PFM in order to improve the implementation of fiscal and development policies; 2) Enhancing the capacity of check and balance state and NSA to play fully their role of adjudicating on policy choices and delivery mechanisms, as well as providing regular oversight and control of, and informing citizens about the delivery of State services.
